plan.planning_summary: Refining route_01 after iteration_11 produced zero physically valid candidates due to overly rigid quarter-wave initialization at 550 nm. Three complementary routes proposed: (1) widened thickness sampling bounds with relaxed margin constraint to guarantee viable candidates, (2) reduced layer count (16 layers) with expanded per-layer optimization budget, (3) asymmetric dual-center initialization separating visible stopband and IR passband design wavelengths. All routes preserve HfO2/SiO2 material pair, fused silica substrate, <=30 layer constraint, and dual-band spectral objectives.

routes.title: Wided Thickness Sampling with Relaxed Margin Constraint
routes.scientific_hypothesis: The previous zero-candidate outcome resulted from overly narrow initialization bounds around 550 nm quarter-wave thicknesses. Expanding thickness sampling to λ/4 ± 30 nm and temporarily relaxing tightest_margin by +0.07 will expand the initial basin of attraction, enabling at least one viable candidate to pass validation and allowing the optimizer to map actual trade-off gradients.
routes.design_principle: Decouple rigid quarter-wave initialization from primary search by sampling layer thicknesses from wider uniform distribution during optimization, enabling gradient-based optimizer to discover non-quarter-wave solutions that better balance dual-band objectives.

routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 550 nm, with sampling bounds of ±30 nm from initialization values. Apply tightest_margin slack adjustment of +0.07. Optimize all 20 layer thicknesses to maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band at normal unpolarized incidence. Total layer count fixed at 20. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with expanded search budget. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
routes.revision_reason: Previous iteration_11 produced 0 valid candidates due to overly narrow initialization bounds. This route widens thickness sampling to λ/4 ± 30 nm and adds +0.07 margin slack per feedback directive to guarantee viable candidates.

routes.title: Reduced Layer Count with Expanded Per-Layer Optimization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count from 20 to 16 layers will decrease optimization dimensionality, allowing more thorough exploration per layer and better convergence. The 16-layer stack should still achieve adequate dual-band performance while improving candidate validity rate.
routes.design_principle: Fewer layers reduce search space dimensionality, enabling more effective gradient-based optimization within fixed computational budget. Quarter-wave initialization at 550 nm with moderate bounds should suffice for 16 layers.

routes.title: Asymmetric Dual-Center Initialization for Separated Bands
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Using different quarter-wave center wavelengths for visible stopband (550 nm) and IR passband (1550 nm) regions within the same stack will better address the dual-band spectral separation requirement. Front layers optimized for visible reflection, rear layers optimized for IR transmission.
routes.design_principle: Asymmetric stack design: first 10 layers initialized at λ/4 @ 550 nm for visible stopband, last 10 layers initialized at λ/4 @ 1550 nm for IR passband optimization. This separates the two spectral objectives spatially within the stack.

research_influence: Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:92993850 confirms telecom C-band (1550 nm) importance for satellite quantum communication, motivating high transmittance objective in 1530-1565 nm band. No literature evidence found for specific HfO2/SiO2 dual-band filter designs, so all routes are theory-based using thin-film interference principles.
Previous iteration_11 failure (0 valid candidates) directly motivated widened bounds and relaxed margin in route_01_refine_01 per feedback directive.
Layer count reduction in route_01_refine_02 addresses optimization dimensionality hypothesis from iteration_11 budget_exhausted status.
Asymmetric initialization in route_01_refine_03 explores alternative topology to overcome symmetric initialization failure.

plan.stop_if_all_routes_fail: Stop after the bounded route portfolio is exhausted or further search stagnates. Return every physically verified candidate and report soft objective trade-offs without a performance admission threshold.
